# Setup rules

Read these before every session.

- Always run the local gate before pushing
- Never force push to main
- Sign every commit

## Testing

- Run the full suite locally, never trust CI first
  including the slow integration half
- Keep tests able to fail for a real reason

```text
- This bullet is inside a fence and is not a rule
```

## Style

- Write commit messages in plain words
- Keep functions short
